source.title: Agents: Gemini 3 through an OpenAI-compatible gateway fails after a tool call because the runtime rewrites the tool-call ID

labels.name: status:in-linear
labels.description: Issue or PR is now in Linear

source.body:
## Bug Description

An agent that uses a Gemini 3 model through an OpenAI-compatible gateway (LiteLLM) fails on the request after a tool call:

```
Function call is missing a thought_signature in functionCall parts. This is required for tools to work correctly, and missing thought_signature may lead to degraded model performance. Additional data, function call `default_api:fetch_input_data` , position 2.
```

We use a `Message an Agent` node (inline agent) with an `openAiApi` credential whose base URL points to the gateway, and the model `openai/gemini-3.x-flash`. Runs with no tool call succeed. The node has no tools of its own, but the runtime adds `fetch_input_data` and `get_environment`, so most runs call a tool. Claude models through the same gateway work.

## To Reproduce

You do not need a Gemini key. A small server that acts like LiteLLM shows the problem.

1. Run n8n 2.46.5 or 2.47.3 (Docker) and enable agents.
2. Start an OpenAI-compatible server that streams `/v1/responses`. On the first request, it returns a function call with `call_id: "call_1779362__thought__AY89a1+JiipVUqj7/74Q"`. This is the format that LiteLLM uses.
3. Create an `openAiApi` credential with the server as the base URL.
4. Create a workflow: Webhook, then `Message an Agent` (inline, `openai/gemini-3.8-flash`, that credential).
5. Call the webhook, then look at the second request that the server gets.

## Expected behavior

The `function_call` and `function_call_output` items in the second request have the `call_id` that the server returned.

## What happens and why

The second request has `call_id: "n8n_a746e645b8da4245c6d34b16c1e84e2a"` on both items.

- LiteLLM puts Gemini's thought signature in the tool-call ID, after `__thought__`, in standard base64. On the next request, it reads the signature back from the ID (`encode_tool_call_id_with_signature` and `get_thought_signature_from_tool` in `litellm/litellm_core_utils/prompt_templates/factory.py`).
- `replayableToolCallId()` in `packages/@n8n/agents/src/runtime/model/messages.ts` replaces each ID that does not match `^[A-Za-z0-9_-]+$` with `n8n_<hash>` when the runtime replays history. It does this for all providers. Standard base64 contains `+`, `/` and `=`, so the signature is lost.
- The gateway then sends the function call to Gemini without a signature, and Gemini rejects it.

The replacement came with #39640, for Anthropic, which rejects these characters. #43234 fixes Gemini's own OpenAI-compatible endpoint, but it does not change this code. LiteLLM servers also stay on the `/responses` route.

## Possible fix

Replay the ID unchanged for providers that do not need the repair. A `keepsToolCallIds` provider quirk for `openai` and `custom` fixes it, and Anthropic keeps the repair. PR to follow.

## Debug info

- n8n 2.46.5 and 2.47.3 (Docker), self-hosted
- Gateway: LiteLLM, OpenAI-compatible, `/v1/responses`
- Models: gemini-3.8-flash, gemini-3.5-flash-lite
